figures.caption: Figure 3.2.1.0. Effect of temperature on the physical properties of 2014 aluminum alloy. The source figure plots thermal conductivity (K), specific heat (C), and mean coefficient of thermal expansion (α) against a shared temperature axis using three separate vertical scales; they are reproduced here as three charts, one per property.

Figure 3.2.1.1.1(a). Effect of temperature on the tensile ultimate strength (Ftu) of 2014-T6, T651, T6510 and T6511 aluminum alloy (bare and clad sheet and plate 0.040-1.500 in. thick; extruded bar, rod and shapes ≤0.750 in. thick with cross-sectional area ≤32 sq. in.).

Figure 3.2.1.1.1(b). Effect of temperature on the ultimate strength (Ftu) of 2014-T6, T651, T6510 and T6511 aluminum alloy (bare and clad sheet 0.020-0.039 in. thick; bare and clad plate 1.501-4.000 in. thick; rolled bar, rod and shapes; hand and die forgings; extruded bar, rod and shapes 0.125-0.749 in. thick with cross-sectional area ≤25 sq. in.).

Figure 3.2.1.1.1(c). Effect of temperature on the tensile yield strength (Fty) of 2014-T6, T651, T6510 and T6511 aluminum alloy (bare and clad plate 3.001-4.000 in. thick; rolled bar, rod and shapes; hand and die forgings; extruded bar, rod and shapes 0.125-0.499 in. thick with cross-sectional area ≤25 sq. in.).
